test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: By selling a cycle for Rs. 5,800, a man gains 45%. What will be the cost price of the cycle?
solution:
**Given:**

Selling Price (S.P) = Rs. 5,800

Profit = 45%

**Formula Used:**

Cost Price (C.P) = Selling Price (S.P) / (1 + Profit%)

**Calculation:**

⇒ C.P = 5,800 / (1 + 45/100)

⇒ C.P = 5,800 / (1 + 0.45)

⇒ C.P = 5,800 / 1.45

⇒ C.P = Rs. 4,000

**The cost price of the cycle is Rs. 4,000.**
